description: Fixed request corpus for TAI latency baselines. Frozen by version: changing any case requires a new corpusVersion, because a baseline compared against a different corpus is not a comparison.
notes: Questions are general-agro and carry no private, tenant or platform-object context, so the corpus can be run against a public contour without authority.
Lengths are request-shape classes, not answer-length targets: short is a bare follow-up, medium a single scoped question, long a multi-constraint question.
The follow-up cases carry history on purpose; a baseline without history would miss prompt-assembly and context-budget cost entirely.

history.text: Причин несколько: питание, влага, густота стояния и болезни.
Тогда смотрим на фосфор, калий и влагообеспеченность.

cases.message: Как уменьшить себестоимость тонны зерна в небольшом хозяйстве без потери урожайности, если техника старая, работников мало, а поля разбросаны на 40 километров и часть из них подтопляется весной?

history.text: How can I raise maize yield?
Consider hybrid choice, soil, nutrition, plant density and moisture.

cases.message: Why has milk yield dropped in my dairy herd?

My combine is leaving too much grain in the field on a wheat crop that lodged after heavy rain; walk me through what to check on ground speed, threshing, sieves and fan settings, and how those interact with straw moisture.

history.text: 冬小麦产量为什么下降？
原因包括养分、水分、密度和病害。

cases.message: 温室黄瓜叶子为什么发黄？
收获后如何安全储存小麦？请说明水分、温度、通风、干燥和虫害监测之间的关系，以及在没有专业烘干设备的小型农场应如何取舍。
